summary: Find the first row-major yellow-4 cell. Round its coordinates down to multiples of four to select the source 3x3 lattice interior, and multiply its local row and column by four to select the destination interior. Collect every source cell other than zero or gray 5, including the marker. Preserve all gray cells while clearing every other cell, then copy the collected source pattern to the same local offsets in the destination.
